agent_explanation: Two heavy bodies (3: m~19.65, 4: m~14.39) fall toward each other: separation shrinks 1.27 (step10) -> 0.92 (step11) -> 0.45 (step12) while speeds rise to ~9.5 and ~8.6. Substeps per step stay capped at 6, so with dt~0.0325 the leapfrog substepping cannot resolve the rapidly growing softened-gravity acceleration at close range, injecting ~68 energy error (E -137.76 vs E0 -206.04). Reducing dt alone removes the violation, confirming timestep-resolution cause.
